questions.explanation: Bearings are always measured clockwise from North and written as three-figure numbers (e.g. $045°$, $270°$).

questions.stem: What is the bearing of due West?
questions.explanation: Starting from North and measuring clockwise: East is $090°$, South is $180°$, West is $270°$.

questions.stem: The bearing of $B$ from $A$ is $060°$. What is the bearing of $A$ from $B$?
questions.explanation: The back bearing differs by $180°$. Since $060° + 180° = 240°$, the bearing of $A$ from $B$ is $240°$.
